pairs.subject: image-prompt-composition
pairs.evidence: lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:237 Every shot prompt is built by the one style compiler with a required StyleBlock. The action half comes from the shot's own fields, so no call can skip or reword the style half.

techniques.evidence: lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:237 promptsForShots needs a StyleBlock and compiles style plus action, and shotReview checks that each prompt restates compileStyleBlock's own output.
lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:215 The order is style, then action, then the constraint. I checked it against lib/stylePrompt.ts:62, which is outside this context.

lib/frames/frames.ts:533 subjectFor builds the subject from the beat's role as countable geometry, never from the beat's sentence. The comment cites the reservation-book leak measured on 6 of 6 styles.
lib/frames/shotReview.ts:483 The vendor's character ceiling is checked before the call, using the compiler's own constant rather than a copy.
lib/frames/shotPrompt.ts:150 The model's default framing was sampled (a dojo A/B) and is overruled one axis at a time with attitude sentences. The lighting clauses name what stays dark.
lib/frames/sceneSpec.ts:137 This is a composited-plate architecture: text goes to the vector layer, and a subject that asks for text is refused.

pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/vocabulary.ts:366 When the engine's answer is unusable, fallbackStyle writes the palette as a plain list of up to five dominant colours, with no ground/figure/accent role. That is the listed palette the technique says gets re-cast on every generation, while the engine path (PALETTE_AS_ROLES) does assign roles.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/extract/vocabulary.ts:366 The fallback recipe lists colours. The engine path requires roles (prompts.ts:19-20), so the two paths disagree.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:120 The full recipe is restated on every replica and transfer, followed by the shot and the constraint.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:4 The recipe leads, the depiction or scene follows, and NO_TEXT is last.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:102 The recipe opens with the medium in the generator's own words, and this rule rests on a measured failure.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:40 Depictions that would attract text are rewritten as shapes, after a measured veto.
lib/foundry/extract/performReplica.ts:48 Each style's negative is written once with its recipe, always contains text and watermark, and is sent verbatim on every call.

lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:56 The style block's word share is sized here. The hard character ceiling is enforced at the provider layer, outside this context (leonardo.ts:133). usableFix sets no upper bound on a recipe_fix.
lib/foundry/extract/prompts.ts:12 Every generation bans text, so the model never sets words.
lib/foundry/extract/performTransfer.ts:4 Replicas and transfers are text-only and carry no reference attachments.

pairs.evidence: lib/producers/still.ts:28 An album still's whole subject is the project title, a proper noun, passed to the image model raw. This is the text magnet the technique names: it invites the model to letter the title onto the plate instead of describing shapes.

techniques.evidence: lib/producers/still.ts:28 The subject is the project title verbatim, with no translation into geometry. The NO_TEXT clause cannot outweigh the noun.

lib/producers/style.ts:138 NEGATIVE_PROMPT includes opposites of a flat-vector look (photorealistic, 3D render, glow, gradient) and is sent with every style, including photoreal or glow-lit extracted styles. A negative not derived from the style's own contract fights it.
lib/producers/frames.ts:230 Frame plates, ad shots and stills all go through compilePrompt with the project's look block.
